findings.title: School Type
findings.description: The 'school' column indicates whether the student attends a public (GP) or private (MS) school.

findings.title: Gender
findings.description: The 'sex' column specifies the gender of the student, with F for female and M for male.

findings.title: Age
findings.description: The 'age' column provides the age of the student.

findings.title: Residence
findings.description: The 'address' column indicates whether the student lives in an urban ('U') or rural ('R') area.

findings.title: Family Size
findings.description: The 'famsize' column categorizes family size as 'LE3' (less than or equal to 3) or 'GT3' (greater than 3).

findings.title: Parental Status
findings.description: The 'Pstatus' column shows the parental status, with A for living with both parents and T for one parent.

findings.title: Number of Rows
findings.description: The dataset has a total of 649 rows.

findings.title: Columns and Their Descriptions
findings.description: Additional details about the columns include: Mjob and Fjob (mother's and father's job), reason (reason for choosing this school), guardian (guardian who helps with education), traveltime (time to travel to school), and failures (number of past class failures).
